data.name: Katti
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Katherine, derived from the Greek word katharos meaning pure. In Christian tradition, the name Katti is associated with the saint Catherine of Alexandria, a renowned martyr and scholar. She is believed to have been a learned woman who converted many pagans to Christianity through her wisdom and devotion.
